steps: Normalize legitimate diary authority and school; preserve original password text.
POST auth JSON and require HTTP200/status OK/String token.
Persist account-owned JWT and password securely.
Call users with requirePupil=false; update account context, module URLs and messagesToken.
Build child choices and choose pupil; load terms for that pupil.
Parse QR URI as documented in discovery-auth.json.
Exchange only code at qrlogin.php on selected diary origin.
Existing matching password account preserves password; QR-only account stores optional refresh and clears password.
Fetch users context and child/year choices.
Read one account-owned credential record; deduplicate refresh by owner.
QR-only account uses stored refresh; password account can perform login with stored password.
Gateway401 invokes unauthorized recovery; gateway itself never retries.
On successful reauth invalidate/rebuild module sessions and retry confirmed safe reads only.
Stale account-generation results must be discarded.
recipes.policy: Last two steps are Siberia reliability design, not observed vendor retry policy.

steps: users.data must be a map. Decode id/role/pupils/firstname/lastname/moduleURLs/messagesToken.
Pupil source callback requires int id and stringifies firstname/lastname with empty defaults.
Account.pupilsOrSelf returns supplied list, or self when list empty, role==1 and userId>0.
Select child under owning account; terms is list and uses id,parentId,label,isYear,dateFrom,dateTo.
Bind cache to owner+child+selected term; never copy account refresh token per child.
Load terms, then marks with string termId.
Join subjects/teachers/markGroups/grades by opaque scoped IDs.
Preserve avg1/avg2, term/proposal/final flags, hierarchy, count-to-average metadata and display value.
Do not infer numeric grade from arbitrary text; averages use provider policy.
Use exact selector and camel-case wire parameters from central catalog.
Timetable wire dates use yyyy-MM-dd wall date, not UTC conversion.
Preserve unknown attendance/status enums and full lesson/exam collections.
Dashboard is mixed dated typed feed; retain unknown element types as explicit unsupported cards.
Load list/pending count; fetch missing detail separately. Opening detail may confirm read state.
Retain userAnswer,declined,pending,pollOpen,answers; type2 empty options defaults TAK/NIE in source.
Submit answer or decline only after explicit user action.
HTTP success alone is insufficient: payload.success must equal true.
Invalidate announcement detail/list/dashboard for same child and reconcile pendingCount.
Fetch eligible events and records independently; selected event IDs come from verified child/day data.
Create JSON includes pupil_id,message,event_ids; update excludes pupil_id; DELETE no body.
These are requests, not direct official attendance modifications.
Preserve raw numeric status; unknown numeric meanings must not be labeled approved/rejected.
After write refresh justifications/detail/eligible events/attendance/dashboard.
Use users.messagingUrl unchanged for GET {url}/{school}/{encodeComponent(messagesToken)} with Accept text/html, build UA, redirects disabled.
Collect Set-Cookie even on302; source strips each cookie after first semicolon and joins pairs.
Persist account mailbox cookie separately. API base removes one exact trailing /sso.
MailJSON headers Cookie,Content-Type application/json,Accept application/json and UA.
401/403 => auth challenge; original wrapper forces SSO and retries once. Avoid replay after uncertain mutation result.
Folder requests POST JSON limit20,skip offset,optional query; response object items,total.
GET read/{id} both reads body and may acknowledge read; model reads subject, while sends use title.
Unread endpoint is separate JSON school/messagesToken call returning integer text.
Mail attachments GET dynamic URL with mailbox Cookie; HTTP200 bytes.
Keep recipient IDs opaque strings. Numeric IDs normalize to user_ prefix; roles may come from role/_type.
Send PUT title,content,odbiorcy string-list and optional previousMessageId; use returned int message id.
Upload each file afterwards as multipart files to that messageID.
Body success followed by failed upload is partial success; show exactly failed attachments and do not resend body.
Star path spelling stared is intentional; star/archive are toggles, not idempotent set operations.
Use users.homeworksUrl, not mailbox/diary origin. GET {H}/{school}/account/ssov2/{encodeComponent(messagesToken)}.
Keep homeworkCookie separate from mailbox Cookie.
JSON requests requireHTTP200;401/419 mean session challenge; empty200 maps to{}.
Original wrapper reauthenticates once; malformedJSON is also null in source but new adapter should surface malformed response separately.
Separate diary homework teachers/items from module data table. Select source using oldHomeworkModule policy only after verifying value semantics.
List active/archive with deadline_at ascending; detail query student is selected pupil.
Upload files with multipart files plus student String. Solution PATCH content,files,student uses exact caller file-reference structure still gated.
Archive PATCH {} toggles source state; refresh after confirmed completion, never blind retry.
Homework download uses dynamic URL without automatic Cookie;401/403 refreshes detail for new URL and asks retry.
Use separately selected legacy mode; never silently fall back from modern auth to legacy password rules.
parent_pass is lowercaseMD5 of original entered password bytes in legacy editor chain.
POST common form to njson.php; Settings protocol must exactly1.6.0.
Apply full/delta table records transactionally using legacy-table-mappings.json, _s I/U/D.
Commit server cursor/db id only after whole supported import succeeds; server db id change forces full.
Read acknowledgement messages.php action=read; discovery ParentStudents can also register FCM token.
